answers.sql: SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN period = 'H1' THEN amount_million ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN period = 'Q2' AND year = 2024 THEN amount_million ELSE 0 END)) AS value FROM expenses WHERE entity = 'Tesla' AND metric = 'R&D' AND year = 2024;

SELECT ((CAST(Q2_Q24 AS REAL) - CAST(Q1_Q24 AS REAL)) / CAST(Q1_Q24 AS REAL) * 100.0) AS value FROM (SELECT (SELECT amount_million FROM expenses WHERE entity = 'Tesla' AND metric = 'R&D' AND year = 2024 AND period = 'Q2') AS Q2_Q24, ((SELECT amount_million FROM expenses WHERE entity = 'Tesla' AND metric = 'R&D' AND year = 2024 AND period = 'H1') - (SELECT amount_million FROM expenses WHERE entity = 'Tesla' AND metric = 'R&D' AND year = 2024 AND period = 'Q2')) AS Q1_Q24) AS calc;
